name: Mealiette Sagitteriaria
original_name: メアリッテ・サジテリアリア
source:
Princess of Neo Sagittaria.
Likes: Waffles, Kuma-kun (her pet frilled-necked lizard).
Dislikes: She finds it scary to look at cutlery.
Hobbies: Playing the bagpipes.
